items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Did you say you used a Harry B.J. though, the cornet? ... Yeah, yeah. I got that here in Chicago.

ctx.x: Did you say you used a Harry B.J. though, the cornet?
Yeah, yeah. I got that here in Chicago. Here in Chicago. You used, you liked that better than the, that was, that was, that was good. I, I liked that, that J.
That was your last horn that you had.
